definitions.explanation: Heavy fog that significantly reduces visibility. A meteorological term often used in weather forecasts and warnings.

examples.japanese: {濃霧|のうむ}のため{飛行機|ひこうき}が{欠航|けっこう}になった。
examples.english: The flight was canceled due to dense fog.

examples.japanese: {濃霧|のうむ}{注意報|ちゅういほう}が{発令|はつれい}された。
examples.english: A dense fog advisory was issued.

examples.japanese: {濃霧|のうむ}で{視界|しかい}がほとんどない。
examples.english: There's almost no visibility due to the dense fog.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{濃|こ}い/のう (dense, thick) + {霧|きり} (fog)

WEATHER TERMINOLOGY:
・{濃霧|のうむ}{注意報|ちゅういほう} - dense fog advisory
・{濃霧|のうむ}{警報|けいほう} - dense fog warning
・{視程|してい} - visibility (technical term)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{濃霧|のうむ}が{発生|はっせい}する (dense fog forms)
・{濃霧|のうむ}に{包|つつ}まれる (to be enveloped in dense fog)
・{濃霧|のうむ}で{視界|しかい}が{悪|わる}い (poor visibility due to fog)
・{濃霧|のうむ}が{晴|は}れる (dense fog lifts)

RELATED WEATHER WORDS:
・{霧|きり} - fog (general)
・{朝靄|あさもや} - morning mist (lighter)
・もや - haze, mist
・{霞|かすみ} - haze (often spring)
